versions.content: If DemEnvironmentDataCapture is equal to DEM_CAP- TURE_SYNCHRONOUS_TO_REPORTING , the Dem module shall queue the environmen- tal data from the reporting (see [SWS_Dem_00805] and [SWS_Dem_01082]) till the next call of the Dem_MainFunction . The Dem shall at minimum queue the configured size (refer DemMaxNumberEventEntryEventBuffer ). In case the queue is full, the environmental data shall be captured when the event is processed in Dem_MainFunc- tion .
